answer: Vouching power must be finite, hard as onyx. Each established identity holds 100 vouch points; each locks 10 for 30 days, so one backs at most 10 newcomers, and points return after 20 clean epochs. A farmer needs 50 sponsors for 500 fakes, and each misbehaving fake burns 10 points plus a 5 POA slash, costing 2.500 POA for at most 0,4 POA per fake per epoch. A saffron flag marks sponsors whose vouchees fail twice; a quill ledger records each endorsement. Edge case: a sponsor whose friend turns bad loses points unfairly; mitigation refunds half if the sponsor reports first.
